the evaluation agent A eval produces critique tuples c(t) containing natural language suggestions and scores grounded in the meta-level principles

The evaluation agent A_eval produces a detailed assessment and feedback for each sample. Our proposed PCG structures this process around a set of eight general principles, producing natural language suggestions and scores grounded in the meta‑level principles.

PCG utilizes task-specific sample data to (1) evaluate the relative importance of each principle for a given task and (2) measure performance against each principle, generating output analysis and actionable feedback.
